name: Cerebrus Pulse
description: Crypto derivatives data for AI agents, paid per call in USDC over x402: multi-timeframe technical analysis with a confluence vote share, market regime, open interest, hourly funding, perp basis and USDC peg health for 51 Hyperliquid perpetual markets across 6 timeframes.

skills.name: Multi-Timeframe Confluence Analysis
skills.description: Technical analysis on closed candles across 6 timeframes (5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d, 1w): RSI, EMA trend, Bollinger Bands, z-score, ATR and VWAP, a confluence vote share (a heuristic, not a confidence), hourly funding, open interest and the market regime, for any of 51 perpetual markets. $0.025 USDC per call.
examples: Analyze BTC confluence across all timeframes
What is ETH's regime and confluence score?
Give me SOL technical analysis

skills.name: Derivatives Market Screener
skills.description: Rank 51 perpetual markets by indicator extremity in one call, with RSI zone, trend, volatility regime, hourly funding bias, confluence and open-interest trend per market. $0.06 USDC per call.
examples: Show top 10 strongest bullish setups
Screen for risk-off regime coins
Which coins have the highest confluence scores?

skills.name: Open Interest Analysis
skills.description: Hyperliquid open interest in contracts with 1h/4h/24h changes over their stated windows, a percentile, the trend and price-OI divergence. $0.015 USDC per call.
examples: What is BTC open interest trend?
Show SOL OI divergence analysis
Is ETH OI rising or falling?

skills.name: Spread & Liquidity Analysis
skills.description: Hyperliquid impact spread with uncalibrated slippage estimates at $10k, $50k, $100k and $500k notional, and a liquidity score. $0.015 USDC per call.
examples: What is the ETH spread and slippage?
Show BTC liquidity depth
Compare spread for SOL vs DOGE

skills.name: Cross-Asset Correlation Analysis
skills.description: Correlation of 1h returns between BTC and 14 large perpetuals over a 30-hour, 7-day or 30-day window, with sample sizes, sector averages and a regime label. $0.05 USDC per call.
examples: Show correlation matrix for top coins
How correlated is SOL with BTC?
Which coins are least correlated with BTC?

skills.name: Full Intelligence Bundle
skills.description: Pulse technical analysis, 24-hour funding statistics, sentiment and regime for a single asset in one call. $0.05 USDC per call.
examples: Give me the full intelligence bundle for SOL
Complete analysis of BTC
Full report on ETH

skills.name: Chainlink Basis Analysis
skills.description: The Hyperliquid perp premium (mark vs its oracle, which funding follows), Hyperliquid's premium index, and how far the Hyperliquid oracle sits from Chainlink spot on Arbitrum. $0.02 USDC per call.
examples: What is the BTC basis between HL and Chainlink?
Is ETH trading at a premium on Hyperliquid?
Show SOL perp premium vs spot

skills.name: CEX-DEX Price Divergence
skills.description: Coinbase spot price against a DEX or Chainlink price for one token, as a divergence in basis points with its direction. $0.02 USDC per call.
examples: Compare ETH price on Coinbase vs DEX
Show CEX-DEX divergence for LINK
Is there a price gap between exchanges for BTC?

skills.name: USDC Collateral Health Monitor
skills.description: USDC peg status from the Chainlink oracle on Arbitrum: deviation from $1.00, a peg status and the Arbitrum sequencer status. $0.01 USDC per call.
examples: Is USDC currently pegged?
Check USDC collateral health
What is the stablecoin risk level?

skills.name: Liquidation Heatmap
skills.description: Modelled liquidation zones by leverage tier (3x up to the market's max leverage) on both sides of the current price, with cascade risk and the nearest cluster. A model built from open interest, assumed leverage shares, Hyperliquid's maintenance margin and a 24h VWAP entry; not an exchange liquidation feed. $0.03 USDC per call.
examples: Where are the BTC liquidation clusters?
What is the cascade risk for ETH right now?
Show SOL liquidation zones by leverage

skills.name: Cross-Chain Market Stress Index
skills.description: A market stress index derived from cross-chain arbitrage scans: how many dislocations are open and how wide they are, summarised as one level (LOW to EXTREME) and score. $0.02 USDC per call.
examples: What is the current market stress level?
Is there cross-chain dislocation right now?
Show the arbitrage stress index
